The Nebraska Lottery offers several draw games for those aiming to win big.

Lucky For Life: 9:38 p.m. CT daily. 2 By 2: By 10 p.m. CT daily. MyDaY: By 10 p.m. CT daily. Lotto America: 9:15 p.m CT Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
